ModMetaData.name: Fast Fire 火焰性能优化
ModMetaData.author: RunningBugs
ModMetaData.description:
大幅优化地图上出现几千甚至上万火苗时的 TPS 与帧率，提供两种模式可在模组设置中随时切换（支持即时热迁移，不丢火苗、不坏档）。
【模式说明】 1. 极限性能模式（默认推荐）：地面静火采用紧凑的网格化仿真引擎（SoA 数组 + 15-tick 分桶 + O(1) 换尾删除），仅在殖民者/AI 实际需要作为目标交互时按需物化代理火苗；附着在角色身上的火保持原版逻辑。彻底消除实体膨胀与暴雨灭火时的 O(N²) 卡顿，大幅降低内存与存档体积。 2. 兼容模式：保留全部地面 Fire 实体以最大化兼容重度魔改火焰的第三方模组，同时剥离五大性能黑洞： - 光照聚合：4×4 区块共享聚合光源，消除上万个独立 CompGlower 对 GlowGrid 与光照网格重建的灾难性开销； - 合批渲染：地面火焰脱离 DynamicDrawManager，采用视野裁剪 + GPU Instancing / 动态合批网格绘制，并对过量 FireGlow 粒子节流； - 寻路防抖：O(1) 火焰寻路代价位图 + 延迟合并增量通知，防止 PathFinder 全图缓存频繁失效重建； - 聚合音效：仅在镜头周围维护最多 4 个区块聚合火焰声源，取代每帧遍历全部火苗； - 15-tick 分桶调度与批处理卸载，兼顾无雪早退、易燃度缓存与 AI/警报空间加速。
两种模式均完整保留原版灭火工作、右键优先灭火、水跳过、泡沫弹出器/泡沫包/泡沫炮塔、水弹、雨/真空灭火、蔓延、烧毁地板与物品、发热、角色着火与逃离等全部互动。开发者模式下提供一键全图生成 10000+ 大小随机火焰的调试按钮用于测试性能与效果。
MIT 开源：https://github.com/lisanhu/rimworld-RimModNotes.git
Significantly improves TPS and FPS when thousands or tens of thousands of fires are burning on a map, with two switchable modes in Mod Settings (supports live migration without losing fires).
[Modes] 1. Extreme Performance Mode (Recommended Default): Simulates static ground fires in a compact grid engine (SoA arrays + 15-tick buckets + O(1) swap-remove) and materializes proxy Fire things only on demand when colonists or AI target them; pawn-attached fires stay vanilla. Eliminates Thing bloat and O(N^2) mass-extinguish freezes while shrinking memory and save size. 2. Compatible Mode: Keeps real Fire Thing instances for maximum third-party mod compatibility while decoupling the five major bottlenecks: - Cluster Lighting: 4x4 chunk glower aggregation instead of 10,000 individual CompGlowers flooding GlowGrid and section meshes; - Batched Rendering: Bypasses DynamicDrawManager with camera-culled GPU instanced / batched rendering and FireGlow fleck throttling; - Pathing Debounce: O(1) fire danger bitmap + coalesced incremental updates so PathFinder grids are not invalidated every tick; - Clustered Audio: Maintains up to 4 camera-local fire sustainers instead of iterating 10,000 reporters per frame; - 15-tick bucketed updates, batch despawn cleanup, snow early-out, flammability caching, and spatial AI/alert acceleration.
Both modes preserve all vanilla fire interactions: firefighting jobs, right-click prioritize extinguishing, Waterskip, firefoam poppers/packs/turrets, water splashes, rain/vacuum extinguishing, fire spread, floor/item burning, heat generation, pawn ignition and fleeing. Includes a Dev Mode debug action to spawn 10,000+ varied-size fires across the map for benchmarking.
